headline: Mod installation and save safety improve as Going Commando gains more matching code
summary: OpenRAC development gains easier mod installs, Windows sound fixes and corrected underwater visibility on Pokitaru; the mod installation work still awaits Windows, macOS and Android runs (OpenRAC#161, OpenRAC#188, OpenRAC#194). The stable branch unusually takes a direct PAL level 11 lighting-bake fix rather than a release PR, while Mod SDK 1.11.0 is published (OpenRAC#189). Archipelago v2.1.0 protects saves from the wrong seed, Difficulty v1.2.4 preserves Blarg Station's own spawns, and Item Randomizer v1.0.4 is released; play-test help is requested for randomizer access logic (openrac-mods#25). Ratchet & Clank's source becomes easier to maintain while retaining fully matched code, Going Commando adds regional matching work, and Deadlocked gains PAL routines. Going Commando's native port is still an unmerged, unplayable draft, and the co-op work also remains draft (OpenRAC#191, OpenRAC#166).
